g.text: PawLocal · Simple cloud monitoring & assisted recovery
Grafana Cloud Free → one AWS Lambda → GitHub-hosted agents → protected existing releases
GROOMING PROPOSAL | 23 OCT 2026 | #59 OBSERVABILITY → #42 INCIDENT RESPONSE
<env> = development | production. Named functions and workflows are proposed.
React: Grafana Faro → hosted frontend intake
Private backend ingestion token stays server-side
MANAGED METRICS + LOKI LOGS + TEMPO TRACES
10k metric series · 50 GB logs · 50 GB traces
Return 204 only after dispatch is accepted
GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runner; fixed workflow ref
Serialized concurrency; check current alert state
One active incident run; finite 20-minute budget
INDEPENDENT MODEL CALL · PROFILE APPROVAL REQUIRED
One coding attempt; redacted telemetry tools
INDEPENDENT MODEL CALL · PROFILE APPROVAL REQUIRED
New context; review pinned patch / candidate
Re-run tests; findings → escalate or publish
No self-approval, merge or deployment tools
TRUSTED JOB · FIXED VALIDATION + GITHUB APP
Validate base SHA / paths / patch / test evidence
Link incident issue + independent review report
Required CI + human review → squash merge
Model output never controls publisher credentials
Record verified release SHA / image digest
Healthy journey + original regression + resolved alert + observation window → close incident. Otherwise escalate to owner.
20-minute TOTAL deadline · 1 coding attempt · 1 active run · approved monthly admission quota required.
Before every model call: reserve approved token/cost bounds. Unset model, rates, quota or token limits → deny admission.
RESOURCE SCOPE One function per enabled environment, plus URL, least-privilege role, exact SSM access and finite CloudWatch Logs.
OWNERSHIP Existing bootstrap / development / production states only. Terraform publishes non-secret Strings; secret payloads stay outside state.
DELIVERY LIMIT GitHub concurrency is not a durable queue or exactly-once delivery. Dispatch retries + issue / PR identity need acceptance tests.
GATES G1 before live responder wiring. #42 needs endpoint ownership and durability-acceptance amendments before affected live activation / acceptance.
METRICS Optional CloudWatch queries do not require forwarding / Firehose. Grafana scoped-read/privacy proof and actual quota consumption remain gates.
